subject: Re: Production latency spikes -> premium SLA pathing and credit request
messages:
From: Alex Harvey <alex.harvey@finlytics.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: priya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0000
Subject: Production latency spikes and upcoming renewal

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from the Finlytics production team — we experienced repeated tail-latency spikes (p99 > 1.5s) across several inference routes last week. The spikes were short (30–90s), but they correlated with a few mobile timeouts and at least one degraded feature flag rollout. Our engineering lead attached a short incident summary for context (incident_summary.pdf).

Our renewal for the Redwood contract is up on 2026-08-10. Given these reliability hiccups, procurement is asking whether you can: 1) confirm what remediation you plan to put in place, 2) provide a credit for the affected window, and 3) outline what commitment path we have to upgrade to a Premium SLA (lower latency SLOs / dedicated capacity) to avoid regressions after renewal.

We'd like to get these items documented before the renewal review next month. Can we set up a quick call?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Harvey
VP Engineering, Finlytics

---
Attachment: incident_summary.pdf (3 pages)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Alex Harvey <alex.harvey@finlytics.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Production latency spikes and upcoming renewal

Alex —

Thank you for the heads-up and for the incident summary. Sorry you ran into this — we take tail latency regressions seriously. Immediate notes and proposed path: 

- Short term (next 72 hrs): Neha's SRE team will run an accelerated investigation (KV cache hit-rate analysis + kernel selection logs). We'll share a short RCA and a mitigation checklist within 48 hours.
- Credit: we can offer a one-time service credit specific to the impacted window. Our standard practice is to compute credit as a % of monthly invoice proportionate to missed SLO. As a starting offer, I'm proposing a 10% credit for June (we can formalize after we agree on scope).
- Premium path: Redwood Premium+ (99.95% uptime, tighter p50/p95 latency SLOs, priority routing, and an option for dedicated small-capacity pools) is available as an addendum. I attached a draft addendum (proposed_sla_addendum.pdf) and a pricing proforma (pricing_proforma.xlsx).

I suggest a 30-minute sync this week to align remediation, the credit calculation, and the Premium trial path (we can provide a 30-day trial of Premium+ as an escalation-friendly option while you decide on a longer commitment). Are you available Thursday 2026-06-26 16:00 UTC or Friday 2026-06-27 11:00 UTC?

Regards,
Jonas Weber

Subject: Re: Production latency spikes and upcoming renewal

Marissa / Jonas — quick SRE note (summary):

- Initial telemetry shows elevated p99 tied to an unusual distribution of long-context requests hitting a GPU kernel path that has higher latency for longer sequences. There are two actionable levers: 1) adjust kernel selection heuristics (software change, low risk, deployable in 72 hrs) and 2) recommend a small dedicated pool for highest-throughput routes (config change + capacity booking, ~2–3 weeks lead).
- Longer-term: we'll add a configuration guard to reduce p99 regressions when sequence lengths shift suddenly.

Recommendation to sales: offer the 30-day Premium+ trial immediately (we can spin a dedicated small pool for their top two production routes and watch for improvements), and push the kernel selection fix in the next patch. If they take the Premium+ 12-month commit, we can discount the monthly rate and apply the full 10% June credit.

Neha Kapoor
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 16:20:00 -0000
Subject: Final proposal: Premium+ trial, credit framework, and next steps (DL-2026-0884)

Alex —

Thanks for the quick sync this morning. Per our conversation, here's the formalized offer so procurement can review: 

1) Immediate actions (today -> 72 hrs):
- Neha's team will deploy the kernel-selection patch to the staging group and begin monitoring production telemetry on the top two routes.
- Redwood will activate a 30-day Premium+ trial for a small dedicated pool (no charge for the trial).

2) Credit framework:
- One-time June credit: 10% of the June invoice applied to the August billing cycle upon execution of the Premium+ addendum for 12 months.
- If Finlytics signs a 6-month Premium+ addendum instead, the credit will be 5%.
- If Finlytics declines Premium+ within 30 days, we will still provide a goodwill credit of 3% for June.

3) Premium+ deliverables (if committed):
- SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime and explicit p50/p95 latency targets per route.
- Priority support, dedicated routing, and quarterly reliability reviews.
- Automated rollback policy and a designated escalation path (Connor O'Brien, Head of Platform Ops).

4) Timeline & paperwork:
- I attached the proposed_sla_addendum.pdf and pricing_proforma.xlsx. If this looks good, I can push a DocuSign draft to your procurement contact (link included). Our HubSpot deal is DL-2026-0884.

Please confirm whether Finlytics is prepared to: A) sign the 12-month Premium+ addendum to receive the 10% credit, B) sign a 6-month addendum for 5% credit, or C) decline and receive the 3% goodwill credit. If you want adjustments to the p95 targets per route, let us know and we'll align Neha's team to propose concrete p95 thresholds.

Appreciate your partnership and we want to make sure reliability meets your production bar.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Director, Redwood Inference
